english.title: Tram driver cause / permit a tram to exceed the speed limit on the Croydon Tramlink system
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being the driver of a tram, namely **(..SPECIFY THE TRAM..), on the Croydon Tramlink system at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..)

(A)_[caused]_
(B)_[permitted]_

that tram to exceed the speed limit, namely **(..SPECIFY SPEED LIMIT..), indicated on a traffic sign erected by an Operator applying to that part of the area through which the tram was travelling
english.legislation: Contrary to Byelaws 12(3) and 26 of the Croydon Tramlink Byelaws made under section 46 of the Croydon Tramlink Act 1994.
